articles.summary: FLOWER MOUND, Texas, Aug. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX ), ("Mannatech" or "Company"), global health and wellness company committed to transforming lives to make a better world, today announced financial results for its second quarter of 2026. Second Quarter Results Net sales for the three months ended June 30, 2026 were $26.7 million, an increase of $1.0 million, as compared to the same period in 2025. On a Constant dollar basis (see Non-GAAP Measures, below) our net sales increased $1.3 million, or 5.1%, and foreign exchange caused a $0.3 million decrease in GAAP net sales as compared to the same period in 2025. Gross profit as a percentage of net sales increased to 76.9% for the three months ended June 30, 2026, as compared to 73.6% for the same period in 2025.
